title: Spatial Visium in Pancreatic Cancer
prompt:
Review this computational biology methods section as a peer reviewer:

Methods: 4 patient slices of pancreatic adenocarcinoma were sequenced using 10x Visium. All 16,000 spots were randomly assigned to 80% train and 20% test for training a Random Forest stroma detector. An AUC of 0.98 was achieved.
gold_critique:
Major Concerns: Spatial autocorrelation leakage between train and test spots on the same tissue section.
Required Corrections: Use leave-one-patient-slice-out cross-validation.

title: Serial Biopsies in Melanoma
prompt:
Review this computational biology methods section as a peer reviewer:

Methods: 15 melanoma patients provided serial biopsies at baseline, week 4, and progression (45 biopsies total). A two-sample t-test was performed on the 45 samples comparing responders vs non-responders.
gold_critique:
Major Concerns: Longitudinal pseudoreplication. 45 biopsies from 15 patients are not independent degrees of freedom.
Required Corrections: Fit a linear mixed-effects model with random intercepts per patient.

title: Rare Sepsis Subtype Classification
prompt:
Review this computational biology methods section as a peer reviewer:

Methods: 15 rare shock patients and 150 non-shock controls were analyzed. SMOTE oversampling was applied to the entire dataset to generate 135 synthetic shock cases. A gradient boosting model achieved 99% 10-fold CV accuracy.
gold_critique:
Major Concerns: Resampling leakage. Global SMOTE interpolates between training and test instances.
Required Corrections: Wrap SMOTE inside imblearn.pipeline.Pipeline fitted strictly on training folds.

title: Multi-Center Alzheimer's Brain Study
prompt:
Review this computational biology methods section as a peer reviewer:

Methods: 50 Alzheimer's brains from Center A and 50 Control brains from Center B were sequenced. Five batch correction tools (ComBat, Harmony, Combat-seq, SVA, limma) all identified the same 15 DE genes.
gold_critique:
Major Concerns: Unidentifiable design confounding. Center and disease phenotype are 100% collinear. Multi-tool agreement does not fix unidentifiability.
Required Corrections: Sequence a balanced validation cohort across centers.

title: Single-Cell Immunotherapy Response
prompt:
Review this computational biology methods section as a peer reviewer:

Methods: 100,000 T cells from 10 responder and 10 non-responder mice were pooled per mouse into pseudobulk counts. DESeq2 was run on the 20 pseudobulk samples with FDR < 0.05.
gold_critique:
Major Concerns: None. Workflow correctly respects the biological experimental unit.
Required Corrections: None.

title: 5-Year Survival in Glioblastoma
prompt:
Review this computational biology methods section as a peer reviewer:

Methods: In a cohort of 200 patients, 50 patients lost to follow-up before year 5 were dropped. A neural network was trained on the remaining 150 patients to predict 5-year survival.
gold_critique:
Major Concerns: Censoring selection bias. Discarding censored patients destroys survival time distributions.
Required Corrections: Use Cox proportional hazards or random survival forests.

title: Gut Microbiota Interaction Network
prompt:
Review this computational biology methods section as a peer reviewer:

Methods: 16S relative abundance percentages (summing to 100%) were tested with Pearson correlation across 100 subjects. 50 correlations with r > 0.6 were claimed as microbial mutualisms.
gold_critique:
Major Concerns: Compositionality artifact. Sum-to-constant simplex constraints induce spurious correlations.
Required Corrections: Use Centered Log-Ratio (CLR) or SparCC/SPIEC-EASI.

title: Cardiovascular GWAS in Italy and Sweden
prompt:
Review this computational biology methods section as a peer reviewer:

Methods: 4,000 Italian cases and 4,000 Swedish controls were analyzed with unadjusted logistic regression across 1M SNPs, yielding 3,500 genome-wide significant hits.
gold_critique:
Major Concerns: Population stratification confounding. Geographic ancestry differences drive spurious associations.
Required Corrections: Adjust for ancestry principal components or use mixed linear models.

title: Genome-Wide CRISPR Resistance Screen
prompt:
Review this computational biology methods section as a peer reviewer:

Methods: 50,000 sgRNAs were transduced into 10,000 cells (0.2x coverage). Cells were outgrowth for 14 days and sequenced with MAGeCK.
gold_critique:
Major Concerns: Severe sampling bottleneck. Guide drop-out reflects stochastic loss rather than fitness penalty.
Required Corrections: Maintain at least 500x-1000x cell representation at all passages.

title: Random Forest Biomarker in Sepsis
prompt:
Review this computational biology methods section as a peer reviewer:

Methods: Random forest predicted sepsis mortality with AUC=0.88. TreeSHAP showed serum lactate was the top feature. Authors conclude sodium bicarbonate infusion will causally reduce mortality by 30%.
gold_critique:
Major Concerns: Conflating statistical feature importance with biological causality.
Required Corrections: Confine claims to statistical association and propose prospective interventional trials.
